tutorial.title: Welcome to IconTale!
tutorial.step1.title: Create or join a lobby
tutorial.step1.body: Create a lobby or join with a 6-character code. At least 3 players are required.
tutorial.step2.title: Write a story
tutorial.step2.body: You get a handful of random emojis. Write a creative story inspired by them.
tutorial.step3.title: Guess
tutorial.step3.body: Read another player's story and guess the emoji combo and the author.
tutorial.step4.title: Score & leaderboard
tutorial.step4.body: Earn points for correct guesses and for keeping your own story secret!
